dialogues.speaker: Coyopa
dialogues.text: The Pyro Archon seems to have been pretty busy lately. The Masters of the Night-Wind haven't made any big announcements, have they?

dialogues.speaker: Coa
dialogues.text: No news on my end. How about you?

dialogues.speaker: Coyopa
dialogues.text: Uh... If I knew what was going on, why would I be asking you?

dialogues.speaker: Coyopa
dialogues.text: ...Well, either way, nothing much we can do about it, and there's no point in just standing here. Why don't we go grab a drink instead?

dialogues.speaker: Coa
dialogues.text: You're not trying to trick me into going to Xocolatl Beverages again, are you? How about... No.

dialogues.speaker: Coyopa
dialogues.text: The Pyro Archon seems to have been pretty busy lately. The Masters of the Night-Wind haven't made any big announcements, have they?

dialogues.speaker: Coa
dialogues.text: No news on my end.

dialogues.speaker: Coa
dialogues.text: Come to think of it though, the Pyro Archon seems to have got everyone searching for a Fatui Harbinger, and there's talk that someone from the Masters of the Night-Wind might be caught up in it all.

dialogues.speaker: Coyopa
dialogues.text: Oh? That doesn't sound too good...

dialogues.speaker: Coa
dialogues.text: *sigh* Things have been a bit too eventful recently for my liking too.

dialogues.speaker: Coa
dialogues.text: So... How about that drink?

dialogues.speaker: Coyopa
dialogues.text: Tlilhua, Vilca, Ekwensu...

dialogues.speaker: Coa
dialogues.text: Kwame, Purum, Inna...

dialogues.speaker: Coa
dialogues.text: Oh, and Nzinga too... Despite being a rookie, she still went without the slightest hint of hesitation...

dialogues.speaker: Coyopa
dialogues.text: It's reached the point that I'm actually hoping for new announcements from the Masters of the Night-Wind.

dialogues.speaker: Coa
dialogues.text: We could all use some good news, that's for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Coa
dialogues.text: But let us not be discouraged! We must not forget the necessity of sacrifice, or the victory we strive for.

dialogues.speaker: Coyopa
dialogues.text: You're right.

dialogues.speaker: Coyopa
dialogues.text: If we get some free time... How about we invite the Pyro Archon out for a drink?

dialogues.speaker: Coyopa
dialogues.text: Have you got everything sorted?

dialogues.speaker: Coa
dialogues.text: Of course. I may not much like paperwork, but I'll manage — through gritted teeth, if I must.

dialogues.speaker: Coyopa
dialogues.text: Impressive. The losses and casualties from the war, not to mention the resources needed for reconstruction... Just thinking about it makes my head spin.

dialogues.speaker: Coa
dialogues.text: *sigh* It's all done now. Let these records gather dust in the Speaker's Chamber. It's time for Natlan to welcome a new dawn.

dialogues.speaker: Coyopa
dialogues.text: Well said!

dialogues.speaker: Coyopa
dialogues.text: Although, seeing as everything's over... There's something I've been meaning to ask...

dialogues.speaker: Coa
dialogues.text: Huh? What is it? Don't be shy.

dialogues.speaker: Coyopa
dialogues.text: Those... fragments in the sky. What are they?

dialogues.speaker: Coa
dialogues.text: Oh! You're curious about those? I'd like to know as well.

dialogues.speaker: Coa
dialogues.text: How about we ask the Pyro Archon the next time we go for a drink?
